func inOrderSteps(_ items: [() async -> Void], reason: String) async {
  for item in items {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await client.put(item)
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await audit.save(item)
  }
}

func use() async throws {
  try await inOrderSteps([], reason: "Each update reads the previous write")
}
